notes: Repairs bounded provider retry/backoff for rate limits and transient upstream failures.
Makes persisted Research recoverable when Angle generation fails, without duplicating Research.
Restores FR-02 multi-Brand creation inside an existing authenticated Workspace.
Strengthens tenant-isolation regressions and authenticated multi-Brand smoke coverage.
Adds exact web/API release-SHA provenance; empty Vercel Git metadata no longer masks the build-generated exact SHA fallback.

Production smoke exposed a Hermes Researcher output-contract gap: factual Claims with empty evidenceIds reached domain validation. Reopen VS-73 testing to fail closed at the runtime boundary and provide explicit Researcher/Strategist Hermes contracts.
Concurrent production smoke requests exposed duplicate Research persistence for the same Idea; make Research and candidate-Angle persistence idempotent after the existing per-Idea database lock.
Final production smoke exposed malformed direct-model Drafter JSON under generic json_object mode; bind content-draft and critic-review to strict provider-side JSON schemas before runtime validation.

Production deployment exposed that the existing Instagram publishing worker was built but never started by the API container; launch that existing worker only when explicitly production-enabled so approved publish commands can reach Meta without changing approval authority.

Live OAuth diagnostics proved the Instagram callback route already exists, but when the Kairo access-token cookie has expired it redirects to the root error path; root then starts Auth0 with returnTo=/ and discards Meta code/state. Preserve the complete local callback path and query through the signed Auth0 transaction so OAuth resumes after sign-in.

Live Meta authorization now reaches the API callback, but Meta can omit expires_in when exchanging the Facebook User token. Treat omission only as a conservative 60-day operational horizon while retaining the existing minimum-lifetime rejection for explicit short expiries, so valid Meta connections are not rejected before account discovery.

Product Owner deferred the remaining deliberate concurrent-Research production verification to issue #142. The historical concurrency defect/fix remains recorded, but that dedicated smoke is not a VS-73 acceptance or certification gate.

approvals.rationale: Owner explicitly instructed the Publish blocker to be fixed and execution to continue through the real Instagram publish test; live logs proved the remaining blocker is Meta token-lifetime compatibility in the OAuth adapter.

The repair does not expand Meta permissions, expose credentials, relax tenant binding, bypass approval authority, or alter publishing execution; it only handles a valid provider response shape while retaining explicit short-token rejection.
Owner said to fix the connection failure and go ahead with live publishing validation.
Fresh exact-head CI and production verification are required after the Meta token-lifetime compatibility repair.
Exact merge SHA will be bound after CI and merge.
Instagram publisher remains enabled; the repaired API must deploy before the user repeats the Meta authorization and provider-confirmed publish smoke.

evidence: Prior certification is historical only. Production verification subsequently exposed publisher startup, OAuth callback-resume and Meta token-lifetime response-shape defects; fresh exact-SHA verification is required.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: Authenticated users can create multiple isolated Brands and reliably progress Brand → Idea → Research → Angles → Campaign → Content → Review → Approval → provider-confirmed Instagram publish under transient provider failures, with exact deployed-SHA provenance.
